title: Vertex AI Agents: Anomaly Detection & Read-Only Properties
summary: Vertex AI introduces a new `AgentAnomalyDetectionScope` resource with full CRUD, alongside extensive new methods for monitoring and analyzing agent sessions and invocations. This release also includes significant breaking changes, making 28 properties across various agent-related schemas read-only.
details:
This release brings substantial new capabilities and breaking changes to Vertex AI. Developers must update their code as numerous properties have been made read-only. These include `state` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1AgentAnomalyDetectionScope`, `location` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1AgentResource`, various fields like `agentDisplayName`, `agentStatus`, `agentType`, `location` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1AggregateAnalyzedSessionsResponseAgentAggregate`, `assessment`, `invocationId`, `invocationState` in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1AnalyzedInvocation`, and many more within `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1AnalyzedSession`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1AnalyzedSessionSeveritySummary`, `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1ListAnalyzedSessionsResponseViewSummary`, and `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1MonitoredAgent`. Any attempts to write to these fields will now fail.

A major new capability is the `AgentAnomalyDetectionScope` resource, now available with `create`, `get`, `list`, and `delete` methods under `projects.locations.agentAnomalyDetectionScopes`. This enables programmatic management of anomaly detection configurations for agents. Agent monitoring and analysis have been significantly expanded with new methods under `projects.locations.monitoredAgents`: `clearTrainingData`, `disable`, `enable`, `get`, and `list`. Furthermore, detailed session analysis is now possible via `projects.locations.monitoredAgents.analyzedSessions.aggregate`, `get`, and `list`, with even finer-grained `analyzedInvocations.get` and `list` methods. A new `projects.locations.agents.search` method provides enhanced discoverability for agents.

Generative AI models gain new `thinkingLevel` enum values and `continuationToken` fields for improved interaction management. Tool usage is enhanced with new `toolCall` and `toolResponse` structures in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1Part`, along with dedicated `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1PartToolCall` and `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1PartToolResponse` schemas, and a new `includeServerSideToolInvocations` option in `GoogleCloudAiplatformV1ToolConfig`.
